retired.question: What name is given to the group of Walt Disney's core lead animators — his top creative team?

retained.question: Which honorary group of animators included Frank Thomas, Ollie Johnston, and Marc Davis?

rationale: Both identify the same honorary group of animators. Retain 960's concrete member names instead of the vague top-creative-team description.

sources.evidence: Nine Old Men was Walt's name for his key animators, including Thomas, Johnston and Davis.
sources.limitations: Primary institutional text inspected; no film or video viewing claimed.

originalOptionAssessments.assessment: Nine Old Men is the documented group name.
Walt's Boys is not the documented name.
The Ink Squad is not the documented name.
The Originals is not the documented name.

finalChallenge.notes: Both identify the same honorary group of animators. Retain 960's concrete member names instead of the vague top-creative-team description. All four original options inspected. Retirement avoids asserting approval of a flawed premise or an insufficiently excluded alternative.

scope: Only the planned ID is retired. Counterpart comparison is not approval of its other claims.
